contents.text:
I'm checking the latest ADR 0127, which puts the project under PolyForm Noncommercial, so commercial use would need a separate arrangement through Louis. The README line about free noncommercial use is enough for me, and I shouldn't invent commercial terms. I'll say the docs grant free noncommercial use under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0, with no company price stated, and point buyers to louis-agent.d

I'm weighing whether to check the README context again, but the line already covers what I need. Next I'm working out which options to offer: reading the licence decision, looking at commercial terms on louis-agent.dev, or walking through getting started, since I can't open that site or send a request on the user's behalf.

The framework's docs don't state a company price, so I can't give you one. This site doesn't sell louis-agent. Sales go through louis-agent.dev, where Louis's own Orbi handles them.

The licence matters for a company. The README says the framework is free for noncommercial use under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0. Commercial use is a different question, and the docs don't set terms for it. Ask on louis-agent.dev.

Source: `src/docs/adr/0127-licence-polyform-noncommercial.md`, with the licence line in `README.md`.

choices.why: Why PolyForm Noncommercial was chosen, and what it allows.

choices.label: Show me the Comparison page
choices.why: louis-agent beside Microsoft Agent Framework and Semantic Kernel.

choices.label: Stop here
choices.why: Go to louis-agent.dev for commercial terms.
